title: Store Bay Standards for Alignment Services & Plans: Inspection, Work Order and Add-On Charges
content:
Every alignment performed under Alignment Services & Plans follows the same bay standards on all six lines; the lines differ only in the steering angle sensor reset charge and the recalibration charge.

## Standards that apply on every line

| Standard | Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Steering and suspension inspected before every alignment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Worn steering or suspension parts must be repaired before the alignment is performed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A visit on which worn parts blocked the alignment uses the interval | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Before-and-after measurement printout given with every alignment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Work order odometer recorded for every alignment | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Add-on charges (USD)

| Line | Steering angle sensor reset after the alignment | Forward camera or radar recalibration, when the vehicle requires one after an alignment |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | 24.99 | 199.99 |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | 0.00 (included) | 199.99 |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | 0.00 (included) | 199.99 |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | 0.00 (included) | 199.99 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | 0.00 (included) | 179.99 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | 0.00 (included) | 179.99 |

A reset charge of 0.00 means the steering angle sensor reset is included.

## Points of judgement

- **Inspection finds a worn tie rod end (hypothetical).** The alignment is not performed until the worn part is repaired, and the visit does not use the interval on any line.
- **Recalibration.** The recalibration charge applies only when the vehicle requires a forward camera or radar recalibration after an alignment; a vehicle that requires none is not charged it.
- **Hypothetical work order on the Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment.** An alignment needing no recalibration carries the 24.99 sensor reset charge; the same alignment on any other line carries 0.00 for the reset.
